response.sql: WITH country_counts AS (SELECT p.birth_country, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM player_college AS pc JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = pc.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), country_stats AS (SELECT birth_country, record_count, record_count * 1.0 / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share, AVG(record_count * 1.0) OVER () AS overall_avg_count FROM country_counts) SELECT SUM(record_count) AS total_record_count, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(record_count - overall_avg_count) AS average_excess FROM country_stats WHERE record_count > overall_avg_count
